import asyncio
from aiohttp.test_utils import TestClient, TestServer
from aiomonitor import Monitor
from aiomonitor.webui.app import init_webui

async def main():
    m = Monitor(asyncio.get_running_loop())
    async with TestClient(TestServer(await init_webui(m))) as c:
        for method, path, kwargs in [('get','/snapshots',{}),('post','/api/snapshot/save',{'json':{'name':'one'}}),('get','/api/snapshot/list',{}),('post','/api/snapshot/tasks',{'json':{'snapshot_id':1}}),('post','/api/snapshot/diff',{'json':{'snapshot_id_1':1,'snapshot_id_2':1}}),('delete','/api/snapshot?snapshot_id=999',{}),('delete','/api/snapshot',{})]:
            r = await getattr(c, method)(path, **kwargs)
            print(method, path, r.status, (await r.text())[:200])
            assert r.status == (404 if '999' in path else 400 if method == 'delete' else 200)
asyncio.run(main())
